intro: Inside an abandoned dojo, Bruno of the Elite Four is meditating before three old hanging scrolls.
introDialogue: Hoo-hah! Welcome to my dojo. These hanging scrolls hold the flow of forgotten techniques! If you want their teaching, prove your inner Ki against me first!
speaker: Bruno
title: Forgotten Dojo
description: A closed dojo where hanging scrolls of body, mind, and linkage sway in silence. Choose one, then defeat Bruno to claim its lesson.
query: Which hanging scroll will you stand before?

1.label: Body Hanging Scroll
1.tooltip:
(!) Battle Bruno
(+) Win to teach the chosen Pokemon Victory Dance
1.selectedDialogue: Hahaha! Excellent! A well-trained body is the foundation of every technique! If you want that strength, overcome my fists!
1.finished: You defeated Bruno, and the Body Hanging Scroll opened!

2.label: Mind Hanging Scroll
2.tooltip:
(!) Battle Bruno
(+) Win to teach the chosen Pokemon Quiver Dance
2.selectedDialogue: Hmm! If you master your mind, even the body's limits can be surpassed! Show me you are ready to accept that flow!
2.finished: You defeated Bruno, and the Mind Hanging Scroll opened!

3.label: Linkage Hanging Scroll
3.tooltip:
(!) Battle Bruno
(+) Win to receive a Baton
3.selected: The strength that links you to your allies is part of true training! Prove your bonds to me!
3.finished: You defeated Bruno, and the Linkage Hanging Scroll granted a Baton!

outro: Keep training hard! I will always welcome your challenge!
